high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the official NASA Kennedy Space Center account (@nasakennedy). The post features a photograph of a Falcon 9 rocket mounted on a launchpad at Kennedy Space Center in Florida. The rocket appears to be part of the Axiom Mission 3, which is scheduled for liftoff on Wednesday, January 17, at 5:11 PM ET.
